name: Windurst
about: A theme that is always there to pick on the Theme page (see launcher_theme.py and README.txt in this folder): the launcher as a storybook of the Federation of Windurst: rounded frames of honey Star Tree wood, a band of green lacquer (the green of the Windurstian flag), gold stars, a sunny page, and Windurst's people from the official colour concept art laid on it like picture-book cut-outs: Shantotto, Ajido-Marujido, Apururu, Kupipi, the Star Onion Brigade, Tarutaru and Mithra, the mages of the ministries, Cardians and the beasts of Sarutabaruta. Its buttons are the pictures in the windurst-ui folder and its banners the windurst_*__theme-windurst pictures (art-src\scripts\wind_buttons.py and wind_banners.py draw them, from art-src\newart and art-src\FFXI_Art_Collection_Part2). Lettering in the pictures is Cherry Swash and Fondamento (art-src\fonts, SIL Open Font License); the launcher's own text stays in the usual font (Segoe UI on Windows). Its song is windurst_theme.mp3. "standard": true makes it what players wear when nothing is picked on the Theme page (the user, 2026-11-25; Chronicle before that).
